import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    B = int(next(it))
    a = [int(next(it)) for _ in range(n)]
    costs = []
    cntEven = 0
    cntOdd = 0
    for i in range(n):
        if a[i] % 2 == 0:
            cntEven += 1
        else:
            cntOdd += 1
        if cntEven == cntOdd and i != n - 1:
            cost = abs(a[i] - a[i+1])
            costs.append(cost)
    costs.sort()
    ans = 0
    for x in costs:
        if B < x:
            break
        B -= x
        ans += 1
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
